lyrics:
1. Come with your music and sing to the Lord,
Praise to the name of the Lord.
Gather and lift up your voice in his praise,
Lord of our gladness, (gladness) and joy.

2. He is your refuge, you people of God...
Master of space and the maker of earth...

3. Offer Him glory and power and praise...
Lord and Creator, our Father and God...

4. Let all the trees clap their hands, shout for joy,
Mountains and hills, bless the Lord, praise his name...

5. Come, priestly people, 0 come. Kingly race,
Sing till the pow'r of the Lord comes on you...
